comparison.objective: Develop an exposed wafer through timed immersion; candidate finishes threaded inserts by impact and recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate wafer handling and manual timing of bath immersion versus mandrel alignment, hammer-force regulation, withdrawal, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Full immersion within the benchmark's 28–32 second surrogate window without process failure versus four safe fractures and physical tang containment.
comparison.reason: Timed chemical-process handling is not mechanically equivalent to contact-driven notch fracture or retained-hardware protection.
